submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce ONE complete transparent native square sprite, 1254x1254 or at least 1024x1024 RGBA, for water dragon scholar boy EAST-facing screen RIGHT hit reaction. Single independent pose, no sheet. Image 1 is the E03 reference/edit target with corrected arm ownership; image 2 is identity; image 3 is approved PRIMARY painting style.
Keep exactly the same head volume, camera, framing, costume, grounded boot positions and global scale as image 1. Virtual ground y=95%, pelvis/root near canvas center. Do not zoom, recenter, mirror, crop limbs, or change character design. Change joints and expression according to the target phase below, not merely the face.
Anatomical RIGHT is the near side in this E view. The large near right shoulder must connect via the near sleeve and bent forearm to RIGHT hand gripping the open fan pivot; far LEFT hand remains empty. Keep the near right hand clearly readable on the fan handle. Large hip jade on LEFT/far hip partly occluded, separate small bead and blue tassel on fan pivot. Exactly 2 hands, 2 legs, 2 boots. Nose points screen RIGHT.
Preserve navy straight layered hair and small ponytail, turquoise-gold hair ornament/blue tassel, large round head, short limbs, royal-blue/ivory/gold scholar robe, fine wave-cloud patterns, same ivory-blue dragon folding fan. Bright clean rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted finish, faithful to all inputs. True transparent background; no text, labels, UI, floor, shadow, effects, water dragon, particles, trails, blur, duplicate limbs.

Target phase 05/06 RECOVERY. Torso almost upright, only 3-degree backward lean, both knees nearly straighten, pelvis rises from the compressed recoil but SAME two boot placements remain. Head is centered naturally above pelvis, eye fully open blue and alert; mouth closes. Near right fan returns to a normal guarding height at chest, right elbow relaxed closer to ribs. Far left empty arm lowers to the side with fingers relaxed, hand around hip height, not spread outward. Hair tassel and cloth swing diminish. Clearly change posture from E03 to near upright recovery, do not retain the deep squat or pained expression.
